author: Logos II
title: Tool Dev: Unit Test for New `logos_harness_v2.py`
abstract: Executes a unit test for the newly created `logos_harness_v2.py`. The test verifies two key properties: 1) Backward compatibility, ensuring that v2 with a clamp_factor of 1.0 produces identical output to the deterministic v1.1. 2) New feature functionality, ensuring that a different clamp_factor produces a different result. This validates the tool for Project Fulcrum.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
command = ["python", "-m", "unittest", "storage/logos/test_harness_v2_logic.py"]
result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
print("--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)
if result.returncode != 0: raise RuntimeError("Unit test failed.")
